# The Rest Is Accountancy brand system

> Two brands on one system. The Rest Is Accountancy is the club, membership and community: black and white, quiet, exact. Stick to Accounting is the media and podcast brand: newsprint and night, tape yellow as the light, black-and-white photos, condensed capitals and marker. There is no grey.

## Rules an agent must follow

- Use the logo files in assets/logos/. Never retype either name in a font.
- Put the podcast logo on white, newsprint or black, never on yellow: its tape label disappears. Below 300px wide, use the wordmark: the tape label is illegible.
- Yellow is tape or highlighter: a label, a strip, a swipe. Never text on a light ground, and never faded.
- Redline (#A8180F) marks corrections, negative figures and the live dot only. The club never uses yellow or hand marks.
- Set data-brand="club" or data-brand="podcast" on a container; components follow it. Add class="ground" to paint that brand's ground.
- Podcast structure has no outlines: separate by fill and space. Lines are for ledgers only, in the --line colour.
- Write in short declaratives with full stops. No exclamation marks. Titles are real questions.

## React

- import { ClubLogo, PodcastLogo } from "@therestisaccountancy/brand/logo"
- PodcastLogo layout: lockup | tagline | wordmark. Both: variant color | reversed | mono, color (mono only), size (width), title (accessible name).
- The root entry exports colors, fonts, themes, themeVariables and logoAssets, with no React.

## Files

- [tokens/tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): colours, type, space, strokes, angles, motion, per-brand roles and settings, and the contrast contract
- [css/brand.css](css/brand.css): the one stylesheet a page needs (loads fonts.css and tokens.css)
- [assets/logos/catalog.json](assets/logos/catalog.json): every logo file with brand, layout, variant, aspect, bytes and PNG size
- [broadcast/state.js](broadcast/state.js): the broadcast kit's layouts, segments and URL state; [broadcast/index.html](broadcast/index.html) is its control room
- [imagery/covers.json](imagery/covers.json): the cover image system (the working paper), its topics and checks; `node scripts/cover-prompt.mjs <topic>` prints a prompt, and assets/covers/ holds a reference per topic
- [index.html](index.html): the brand guide, showing every class at work, with a cover maker that exports PNGs

## Logos

- Stick to Accounting: sta-{lockup|tagline|wordmark}-{color|reversed|mono}.svg
- The Rest Is Accountancy: tria-wordmark-{color|reversed|mono}.svg
- mono files draw in currentColor. Every non-mono file has a 2000px PNG in assets/logos/png/.

## Typefaces (bundled, OFL)

- Geist Serif: club display. One weight, 400. No italic, so never ask it for bold or italic.
- Anton: podcast display. Capitals, one weight, 400.
- Gochi Hand: podcast marker notes, one short phrase per layout.
- Instrument Sans: text, UI and figures.
- Geist Mono: code and hex values.
- Geist Pixel: podcast timecodes and the live label. One weight, 400. Never in the club.
